Create a funnel chart

Source: R/funnel_chart.R
funnel_chart.Rd

Draws the stages of a process (visits, sign-ups, purchases, ...) as centred bars whose width is proportional to their value, from the first stage at the top to the last at the bottom. The conversion from one stage to the next is written between the bars and the share of the first stage on the right.

Usage

funnel_chart(
  data,
  stage,
  value,
  colors = NULL,
  shape = c("funnel", "bars"),
  show_conversion = TRUE,
  show_percent = TRUE,
  value_format = ",.0f",
  label_font_size = 12,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per stage, in order (or a factor giving the order). Rows of the same stage are added up.

stage

The name of the column with the stages.

value

The name of the numeric column with the values.

colors

Optional. One colour (the stages get lighter shades of it) or one colour per stage. Defaults to shades of blue.

shape

"funnel" (the default) joins the bars with a funnel shape; "bars" draws the bars alone.

show_conversion

Logical. Write the conversion from each stage to the next between the bars. Defaults to TRUE.

show_percent

Logical. Write the share of the first stage on the right. Defaults to TRUE.

value_format

A d3 format for the values. Defaults to ",.0f".

label_font_size

The font size of the labels. Defaults to 12.

hover

Logical. Show tooltips and highlight on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Grow the bars when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text. Defaults to "#333333".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Hover a stage to see its value, its share of the first stage, the conversion from the previous stage and how many were lost on the way. The bars grow one after the other when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking a stage sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with stage, value, percent_of_first and conversion.

Examples

shop <- data.frame(
  step = c("Visited the site", "Viewed a product", "Added to cart",
           "Started checkout", "Paid"),
  users = c(12000, 7400, 2900, 1650, 1180)
)
funnel_chart(shop, stage = "step", value = "users",
             title = "Online shop, last 30 days")



hiring <- data.frame(
  stage = c("Applications", "Screened", "Interviewed", "Offer", "Hired"),
  people = c(420, 160, 48, 12, 9)
)
funnel_chart(hiring, stage = "stage", value = "people", shape = "bars",
             colors = "#3ca951")
